notes: Account profile: EU-based BPO with 12 regional contact centers across EU + LatAm; supports EN/ES/PT/FR/AR and growing APAC pilots.

Primary asks: reduce AHT for multilingual chats, accurate locale-aware tone, live agent assist (suggest responses + next-action buttons), ticket summarization for 3rd-line escalations, and safe function/tool calling into Zendesk and internal ticketing.

POC approach: 6-week split POC. Week 1-2 canonical dataset ingest + prompt tuning for locale tone. Week 3-4 integrated agent-assist via web-socket demo (tool-calls to Zendesk). Week 5-6 load/latency tests and security review. Deliverable: POC report + pass/fail on SLAs.

Performance targets (customer): p50 <= 400ms for small replies in EU region; p95 <= 900ms under normal load; sustain 4k messages/min across regions during peak; agent suggestions delivered in <600ms p50.

Quality targets: 95% auto-detect language accuracy on incoming messages; 90% locale-appropriate tone per sampling evals; ticket-summary brevity target: 25-50 words with key fields (root-cause, steps, recommended next-action).
Security/residency: must store KV cache and logs in customer VPC in EU region; 30-90 day retention depending on queue; KMS for any keys; SOC2 + ISO27001 required.

Tooling & integration: Zendesk + internal CRM + SFTP for nightly transcripts; function-calling requirements: create_ticket, escalate_to_supervisor, redact_pii. Need examples of webhook payloads from Redwood for legal review.

Spikes & reliability: business-critical seasonal spikes (Black Friday-style promos in LatAm) — want graceful degradation plan: fallback to smaller quantized model for non-sensitive payloads + region-based routing to excess capacity in DE/IE.
